messages:
Leah M: quick cross-team question: we keep talking about ephemeral onboarding claims vs immediate peering for Private CP. proposing we formalize a 2-phase path: 1) ephemeral claim bootstrap for fast trials, 2) optional provisioning step to create ENI/peering for steady state. thoughts?
Omar Q: sounds pragmatic. principle: avoid heavy ops for trial users. detail: claim should be single-use, bound to agent pubkey, and require outbound mTLS within TTL.
Tess R: agree. for security we should support two PoP modes: simple claim token (console/API) and KMS-signed nonce for high-security customers. also add consumed_from_ip in audit log.
Leah M: good call. network strategy: prefer PrivateLink for bootstrap if available, otherwise regional relay. later provisioning can create ENI or peering based on customer tier.
infra-bot: ops note: rate-limit claims per-account/ip; emit metrics: claims.created, claims.consumed, claims.revoked, claim_gc_runs. cap concurrent claims to 10 per account by default.
Danny (prod): product: UX is "Create claim" -> run CLI -> success. need admin revoke and claim history in console. SOC2 teams will ask for consumed_by and timestamps.
Omar Q: failure modes? if agent obtains cert but never attaches routes, we need a revoke API and GC. edge should validate route assertion expiry before accepting traffic.
Tess R: also consider team-claim mode (issue short-lived intermediate CA) for multi-machine bootstraps; opt-in only. higher blast radius so require explicit approval.
Leah M: cost impact: relay fallback scales with onboarding RPS. I'll model 3 scenarios (500/day, 5k/day, 20k/day) to estimate relay instance-hours and avg p99 latency.
Omar Q: implementation notes: claim state machine CREATED->CONSUMED->ACTIVE->EXPIRED and one-time-use token with nonce binding. require PoP during handshake.
Danny (prod): schedule: spike + threat-model + short RFC next sprint. who pairs on threat model?
Tess R: I'll pair on threat model and edge validation.
Leah M: thanks all, will post spike results and draft RFC link here.
infra-bot: ticket INFRA-1801 created for relay capacity spike.
